name: aivexus-local-test
description: Opt-in AIVEXUS Windows QA runtime status and fixed synthetic self-tests via private local MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect the running local AIVEXUS QA app
interface.longDescription: Limited local diagnostic MCP tools. The status tools read sanitized data; starting or cancelling a fixed synthetic runtime test can change local runtime activity. No personal chats or arbitrary shell access.
defaultPrompt: Use AIVEXUS Local Test instance_info to identify the running app.
Read the status of an existing AIVEXUS runtime test without starting another.
